source.directorySummary: Directory implements the file download subcommand — adapter parsing, command definition, request handling, and Nostr/Blossom sync that decodes naddr, fetches and validates the file-share event, integrity-checks, decrypts, and writes the file to the workspace with up-to-date and conflict handling.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapter extracts optional naddr string from FileCommandAdapterParams and delegates to handleDownloadCommand, returning its text result.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Defines download SubcommandDefinition with name download, summary to download and decrypt by naddr, optional naddr string argument, and usage examples.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Handler validates naddr presence for usage guidance, resolves workspace root and Nostr config, calls fileDownload, and maps skipped, success, and error outcomes to text results.

sync.ts.sourceSummary: Implements fileDownload that decodes and validates naddr kind, fetches the file event via SimplePool, validates url/x/hash tags, checks local hash against plaintext/prev for skip or conflict handling, downloads and hash-verifies the Blossom blob, decrypts via NIP-44 conversation key and AES-GCM, and writes to the resolved workspace path.

summary.value: Directory implements the file download subcommand — adapter parsing, command definition, request handling, and Nostr/Blossom sync that decodes naddr, fetches and validates the file-share event, integrity-checks, decrypts, and writes the file to the workspace with up-to-date and conflict handling.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Leaf secure-transfer subcommand that forms the consumer side of the file plugin's upload/download pair within the 20-command commands aggregation. Sits below the centralized handleFile dispatcher and init registration boundary and is invoked via the standard adapter → handler → sync fan-out; isolates the external-content trust boundary (Nostr event authenticity, Blossom blob integrity, NIP-44 decryption, workspace containment and idempotency/conflict policy) from the plugin's browsing/edit/git and bottom-up families, exposing only a minimal naddr entry point to CLI/web callers.

files.adapter.ts: Thin CLI/web adaptation shim in the file plugin's validate → execute → adapt pattern; extracts the optional naddr from FileCommandAdapterParams and delegates to the domain handler, keeping transport/parsing concerns out of sync logic consistent with sibling command adapters under the central dispatcher.
files.definition.ts: Declarative SubcommandDefinition contract registered via the plugin init subcommand table; provides the name, summary, optional naddr argument and usage examples that the central dispatcher uses for routing, help generation, and validation before adapter/handler execution.
files.handler.ts: Orchestration and presentation boundary for the download flow; enforces preconditions (naddr presence for usage guidance, workspace-root and Nostr config resolution) and normalizes fileDownload domain outcomes (skipped/up-to-date, success, conflict, error) into text results for CLI and web renderer consumption.
files.sync.ts: Encapsulated domain core owning the end-to-end Nostr/Blossom trust pipeline — naddr decode/kind validation, SimplePool event fetch, url/x/hash tag checks, local hash comparison for skip/conflict decisions, Blossom blob download with hash verification, NIP-44 conversation-key and AES-GCM decryption, and contained workspace write — isolating network/crypto/I/O and idempotency policy from adapter/handler layers.
